chunks.title: Hostel Fees, Food Mess, and Uniform Charges at Narula Institute of Technology
chunks.content:
Hostel and Facility Charges at Narula Institute of Technology:
• Hostel Fees: ₹6,500 per month (6 months semester = ₹39,000) plus one-time admission fee of ₹5,000. Total payable at admission is ₹44,000.
• Hostel Facilities: Separate secure hostels for boys and girls, 24/7 security, Wi-Fi, power backup, and hygienic mess food (veg & non-veg).
• Uniform Charges: ₹6,000 one-time for B.Tech, BCA, BBA, and Diploma students (₹2,500 for MCA & M.Tech).
• Payment Terms: All fees must be paid through online portal only. EMI and education loan assistance available.

chunks.title: Campus Placements, Highest Package, Average Salary, and Placement Percentage at Narula Institute of Technology
chunks.content:
Campus Placement Statistics and Recruiter Records at Narula Institute of Technology (NIT):
• Overall Placement Percentage: 88%+ consistent placement rate across engineering and technology departments.
• Highest Salary Package: ₹18 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum).
• Average Salary Package: ₹5.2 LPA.
• Total Offers: 1000+ job offers generated for eligible graduates.
• Top Recruiters: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Cognizant, Wipro, Capgemini, Infosys, Amazon, Tech Mahindra, Mindtree, LTI, and IBM.
• Industry Labs: Dedicated Apple iOS Developer Training Center, AI & Robotics Centers of Excellence.
• Placement Assistance: Pre-placement soft skills training, mock interviews, and technical coding bootcamps starting from 3rd year.

chunks.title: All Departments, Streams, Branches, and Courses Offered at Narula Institute of Technology (NIT)
chunks.content:
Departments, Branches, Streams, and Seat Distribution at Narula Institute of Technology (NIT):
• B.Tech (UG - 11 Streams): CSE (300 seats), CSE AI & ML (240 seats), IT (180 seats), ECE (150 seats), CSE Data Science (120 seats), EE (60 seats), CE (60 seats), ME (60 seats), CST (60 seats), CSBS (60 seats), ECS (30 seats).
• Postgraduate (PG): M.Tech in CSE, ECE, EE, CE (18 seats each) and MCA (60 seats).
• Undergraduate Management & Computer Applications: BCA (120 seats) and BBA (60 seats).
• Diploma / Polytechnic: Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and ETCE (30 to 60 seats per branch).
Total Capacity: 2000+ seats across 23+ programs and 11+ engineering/management departments.

chunks.title: Mandatory Documents Required for Admission and Physical Verification
chunks.content:
Mandatory Document Checklist for Physical Verification at Narula Institute of Technology:
1. WBJEE / JEE Main / JELET / JECA Rank Card
2. Provisional Seat Allotment Letter from Centralized Counseling
3. 10th Standard Admit Card / Birth Certificate (Proof of Age)
4. 10th and 12th Standard Mark sheets and Passing Certificates
5. Domicile Certificate (for West Bengal domicile quota / TFW / SVMCM)
6. Category / Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-A/OBC-B/PwD if applicable)
7. Family Income Certificate (issued by SDO/BDO for SVMCM/TFW)
8. Medical Fitness Certificate and Eye Test Certificate
9. 5 Passport Size Color Photographs
10. Copy of Aadhaar Card (Student and Parent)
11. Anti-Ragging Undertakings signed online by student and parent on antiragging.in
